description: Python generator: report untranslated skill names + optional curated PT-BR override map (FIX 3). The Argos model left 348 skill proper-noun names untranslated (name == name_en, e.g. 'Plaguelands'). PRIMARY deliverable: add a `--report-untranslated` flag to tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py that lists and counts skill names where name==name_en so the maintainer can review, without fabricating translations. OPTIONAL: add a SMALL, correct curated override map file tools/dictionary-generator/name_overrides_pt_br.json that is merged during skill-tooltip generation for obviously-translatable names. This tool runs and is verified in this sandbox (py_compile + --dry-run self-checks). The report is derived from the existing generated dataset (data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json) so it needs no network. If the curated override map is added, note in findings that the orchestrator must regenerate the dataset.
steps: Add a `--report-untranslated` argument in parse_args() of tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py (action='store_true', help text in the same PT-BR style as the other flags). In main(), handle it early (like --dry-run / --install-model): load the existing dataset from args.skilldata_output_dir / 'skills_tooltips.json' (default data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json), iterate skills, collect those where (name or '').strip() == (name_en or '').strip() and name_en is non-empty, print the total count and the list of untranslated name_en values (sorted), then return 0. If the dataset file is missing, print a clear message and return a non-zero code. Do NOT fabricate translations here.

Refactor the untranslated-collection logic into a small pure helper, e.g. `collect_untranslated_names(dataset: dict) -> list[str]`, so it can be unit-checked offline. Place it near build_skill_tooltips_dataset.

OPTIONAL curated overrides: create tools/dictionary-generator/name_overrides_pt_br.json as a JSON object mapping English skill name -> correct PT-BR translation. Keep it SMALL and only include names that are unambiguously translatable and clearly correct in GW2 context (do NOT translate proper nouns that official es/fr/de keep in English). If unsure whether any given name is safe to translate, prefer leaving the file with a minimal set (even empty-ish is acceptable) rather than guessing. Add a loader that reads this file (case-insensitive keyed on the trimmed English name, mirroring normalize_key) and, inside generate_skill_tooltips() when computing the skill 'name', applies the override BEFORE falling back to Argos translation of name_en. The override must only affect the skill display name, not name_en. Guard the file read so a missing file is a no-op (empty map). If you add this override behavior, record in findings that a dataset regen is required.

Add offline self-checks in run_self_checks() (invoked by --dry-run): (a) collect_untranslated_names on a synthetic dataset returns exactly the entries where name==name_en (including case-normalized equality if you normalize) and excludes empty name_en; (b) if the override loader/merge is implemented, a check that an override for a given English name is applied to the skill 'name' while name_en is unchanged, and that a name absent from the map is left to normal translation. Follow the existing `check(name, cond)` pattern and keep the checks network-free.
Do NOT run a full generation and do NOT regenerate data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json (the orchestrator regenerates). Verify only with py_compile and --dry-run.
acceptance_criteria: `python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --report-untranslated` prints a count (348 for the current shipped dataset) and the sorted list of untranslated skill names, then exits 0.
Running the report against a missing dataset prints a clear message and exits non-zero.
`python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --dry-run` exits 0 with all self-checks (including the new untranslated/override checks) passing.
If a curated override map is added, name_overrides_pt_br.json is valid JSON and the merge affects only the skill display 'name', never 'name_en'.
No fabricated/guessed translations are introduced into the shipped dataset by this feature (the coder does not regenerate).
verification: Run `python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --dry-run` and confirm exit code 0 and all self-checks pass.
Run `python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --report-untranslated` and confirm it prints count 348 and exits 0.
findings:
Implemented in tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py. PRIMARY (--report-untranslated) done and verified: reads existing dataset (honors --skilldata-output-dir), collects skills where name==name_en (trim) with non-empty name_en via new pure helper collect_untranslated_names(dataset), prints count + sorted list, exits 0. Confirmed count == 348 for the shipped dataset (2963 skills). Missing dataset prints a clear message and exits 1 (verified with --skilldata-output-dir /tmp/nope). Handled early in main() alongside --dry-run/--install-model.

OPTIONAL override map: added tools/dictionary-generator/name_overrides_pt_br.json (loader load_name_overrides + apply_name_override, keyed case-insensitively via normalize_key) merged into the skill display 'name' in generate_skill_tooltips() via _tr_name() BEFORE the Argos fallback; only affects 'name', never 'name_en'; missing file is a no-op (empty map). Deliberately shipped the override file EMPTY: all 348 untranslated names are GW2 skill proper nouns (e.g. Plaguelands, Blink, Berserk, Dhuumfire, Elixir B) that official es/fr/de keep in English or are ambiguous, so per the spec I left it minimal rather than guessing. NO fabricated translations introduced.

DATASET REGEN: NOT required for this feature as shipped, because the override map is empty (merge is a no-op) and no C++/data changes were made. If/when the maintainer later populates name_overrides_pt_br.json, the orchestrator MUST regenerate data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json for overrides to take effect.

SQLite question (user Q3): no code change. JSON kept per orchestrator decision (2963-record ~5MB dataset loaded once into an in-memory O(1) map; nlohmann::json already a dependency; SQLite would add complexity without benefit).

Self-checks added to run_self_checks() (network-free, --dry-run): (l) collect_untranslated_names returns exactly name==name_en with trim, ignores empty name_en, sorted+deduped; (m) apply_name_override case-insensitive hit + '' on miss; (n) load_name_overrides missing=empty, case-insensitive indexing, drops empty keys/values.

Verification (all pass): py_compile of generate_dictionaries.py + gw2_api.py; --dry-run exit 0 (14 checks OK); --report-untranslated prints 348 and exits 0; missing-dataset exits 1. Did NOT run full generation and did NOT regenerate the shipped dataset. No C++ files touched.
